Bringing Vulpix to Life in 3D
Cute, clever, and full of fiery charm, Vulpix is a Fire-type Pokémon from the original Kanto region.
With its six beautiful tails and ability to control flames, Vulpix is a beloved Gen 1 Pokémon that eventually evolves into the elegant Ninetales.
A classic Gen 1 Pokémon brought to life as a 3D printed and hand-painted Pokémon card. #vulpix #pokemon #miniaturepainting #3dprinting #instareels
